limitations: The built-in rules inspect bounded supplied artifacts; absence of findings does not establish safety.
Isolated laboratory acceptance and production integrations require separate execution evidence.
Unsupported formats require a registered acquisition or parsing adapter with pinned prerequisites.
Offline inspection cannot establish live provider or production readiness.
Only bounded blobs reachable from local refs and detached HEAD are inspected; linked worktrees, alternate object stores, and symlinked Git metadata are rejected.
Provider revocation and rotation require registered-adapter:provider-revocation-check@1 evidence.
Content hashes establish internal integrity only, not source authenticity or authorization.
